component_F.text: Source problem: empty-list transformation in LabelEncoder behaved differently after numeric versus string fitting, with the report showing a TypeError for string classes. The local reproducer covered fitting [1, 2] and ['a', 'b']; added checks also covered ordinary string transformation and rejection of an unseen label. The agent-local test file run, `pytest -q sklearn/preprocessing/tests/test_label.py`, passed 19 tests with 3 xfailed. These local results do not establish broader behavior or compatibility; other APIs, input forms, and versions were not verified. The actual official outcome for the submitted patch was unresolved, official_resolved=false, despite those local checks.
component_F.interpretation: Source observations, local validation, limitations and official outcome. Source attempt implementation detail P is omitted; this is not a current-task validation result.

component_P.text: In this repository and local environment, a tentative approach was to check for zero-length input in LabelEncoder.transform after fitted-state and column_or_1d validation, then return an empty np.intp array before np.unique/searchsorted.
